sampling_method: Every own-result cell in frame_locations was assigned a contiguous 1-based index in reading order (location order below; row-major within a table, and for tables whose column set is split across repeated per-page column blocks -- Tables 11, 13, 14, 15, each a wide language grid re-wrapped every ~13-14 columns -- block-major then row-major-within-block, matching the order the blocks are physically printed). This gave a population of 1..2222. random.seed(20260810); random.sample(range(1, 2223), 15) drew {3, 19, 184, 200, 222, 392, 449, 1109, 1252, 1323, 1454, 1573, 1711, 1725, 1948}; each label below records its draw as frame_index. Verified by running the draw as a script (scratchpad labelling/frame.py) against the same row/column label lists used to locate each drawn cell, and cross-checked by re-deriving several drawn cells independently with awk against the raw text dump.
